digest.component_or_area: CloudWatch alarm configuration and SNS notifications
propositions: rebar-gerrit-voter-errors alarm has no alarm_actions or ok_actions declared, so CloudWatch transitions fire silently with no SNS notification
rebar-gerrit-replication-errors alarm has the identical defect: no actions wired despite the prevailing pattern in other monitoring files
Ten of twelve rebar-* alarms correctly wire aws_sns_topic.alerts for alarm and OK notifications; s4b and s5 are the only outliers
The voter_errors alarm is a safety net for the LLM-Review gate; silent failure means changes become unsubmittable with no operator notification
